backend/main.mo: Implements the backend actor for posts, media storage, access control, user profiles, and admin-only CRUD operations including timestamp updates.
backend/migration.mo: Defines a migration module with a no-op run function that returns an empty actor.
feature_evidence.json: Describes feature evidence linking specific frontend files to a feature enabling admin-triggered timestamp updates.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of all frontend files for reference or tooling.
frontend/index.css: Sets global Tailwind layers and defines light/dark theme color variables and base styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React application via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures TanStack Router routes for home, post detail, and admin pages with AppLayout.
Protects admin routes by checking admin status and rendering denial or loading states.
frontend/src/components/AllowlistManager: UI for admins to grant, revoke, and check access permissions using principal IDs.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Wraps pages with top navigation, footer, theme provider, and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/AsyncState.tsx: Displays an error UI with optional retry handling for async operations.
frontend/src/components/AuthButton.tsx: Handles Internet Identity login/logout with loading states and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/MediaGallery.tsx: Renders image and video attachments from backend-provided blob URLs.
frontend/src/components/MediaUploader.ts: Handles image/video file selection and upload with progress tracking and calls backend mutation to attach media to a post.
frontend/src/components/TopNav.tsx: Renders the top navigation bar with logo, navigation buttons, admin link when applicable, and authentication control.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminStatus.ts: Checks whether the current authenticated user is an admin using the backend actor and returns loading and status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, loading stored identities, handling login, logout, and identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for posts, access control, and media operations, all backed by the dynamic backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and theme variables for light and dark modes, plus custom utilities and typography.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Implements the admin interface for creating, editing, deleting, timestamping posts, and managing allowlist and media uploads.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Displays a sorted feed of posts with loading, error, empty, and admin-only creation states, allowing navigation to individual post pages.
frontend/src/pages/PostDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed post content including locked-state handling, authentication checks, and optional media, with loading and error fallback UI.
frontend/src/utils/date.ts: Formats Unix timestamps into human‑readable Australia/Sydney dates.
frontend/src/utils/principal.ts: Validates and parses Dfinity principal IDs, returning structured success or error info.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hash routing, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind themes, colors, fonts, animations, and content scanning for the frontend.
project_state.json: Describes current project requirements, architecture, known issues, and feature versions for the journaling site.
